latest_primary_comparison.revision_boundary: Operator paused the parent sequence during753 pressure to apply a later hotfix before B/C.753 physical-container/scale observations remain753 and are not future-core performance.

frozen_targets.fairness: all eligible mixed receivers served; no added local priority
frozen_targets.integrity: ownership, lifecycle, and queue safety regression tests must pass

unchanged_scopes.DB30: Successful database transaction reduction per identical240-input primary window, assessed individually for same/cross/mixed. Preserve repeat medians and each paired repeat; not restricted to same-server.
unchanged_scopes.same_p95_40: Median of repeat full-output upper-bound p95;40% reduction.
unchanged_scopes.cross_p95_20: Median of repeat full-output upper-bound p95; at most20% regression.
unchanged_scopes.idle_DB30: Separate native idle experiment; not evaluated by these primary FE reports.
unchanged_scopes.descriptive_default10: 10% comparison flag is distinct from frozen cross20% acceptance goal; not a significance test.
unchanged_scopes.fairness: Every mixed receiver served cumulatively; actual endpoint amounts and gaps retained.

measurement_limits.counter_window: Main paths and hotspot capture counter_end after fixed drive and before final conservation drain. Costs are per fixed input window plus actual status/SQL capture boundaries, not a complete drained lifecycle. Some work may complete during final capture; later drain work has no measured counter delta and is never backfilled. Backpressure recovery and its drain occur before counter_end, so its measured window includes recovery. Warmup/low-flow, registration and final cleanup are outside the steady cost window.
measurement_limits.latency: Actual capability acceptance to actual external capability pull, bounded by one Python monotonic observer. No world-save or physical-chest timing claim.
measurement_limits.quantiles: Each40-probe repeat retained. Aggregate is median of the three per-repeat percentiles, not pooled120-probe p95. Nearest-rank p99 at40 observations equals the maximum; no population tail guarantee.
measurement_limits.fixed_work: Primary samples each240 attempts x32000 FE =7680000 FE; low40x1024 and warmup60x32000 are separate. Hotspot has240 rounds x7 sources =1680 inputs; do not relabel it per240 source events.
measurement_limits.SQL: performance_schema account summary WHERE USER='ct_dev', statement/sql/* events only; counts attempts including retries, not JDBC round trips. Account-wide, including any running perf JVM.
measurement_limits.observer_account: Root reads performance_schema; ct_dev workload-account summary excludes those observer SQL reads. Both source reports record no other live backend sessions.
measurement_limits.WAL: Original counts/bytes/barriers and Sql-helper/batch counters are UNMEASURED, not zero.
measurement_limits.fairness: max_unserved_seconds is gap between actual successful pulls, with phase edges included; it does not prove a pending eligible demand waited that long.
measurement_limits.throughput: Given fixed load and sequential RCON driver. Preserve planned/actual rounds, late rounds, duration and RTT. Unsaturated observer does not establish factory capacity or overload limit.
measurement_limits.conservation: All phases and final drain conserved. Latest per-reused-channel checkpoint matches independent ledger; never sum cumulative repeat totals or SQL/WAL resource copies. Conservation does not measure unrecorded tail SQL cost.
measurement_limits.RCON: Operator ran one business observer without concurrent sidecars. Native shared console buffer has no body nonce; business driver did not retain complete raw replies. Prefix/amount/ledger checks passed; no wrong amount/timing proven.
measurement_limits.code_identity: Runtime87 supplied by operator and archived87 launch argfiles; git_head753 identifies checkout, not loaded classes. Original harness lacks class-loader CodeSource attestation.
measurement_limits.unmeasured: No accompanying whole-phase native Minecraft MSPT/TPS, baseline WAL or unrecorded tail costs are reconstructed.
measurement_limits.old4cf: Historical4cfff0a comparisons remain historical and are not latest753 results.

initial_original_container_timeout_retai.detail: Initial10-probe/120s attempt: second same probe observed source32/target0 throughout and no source decrement. Its E2E stays unmeasured; subsequent2-probe/420s success is a separate cohort.
